### Counter-proofs
- "Do only the start": excluded — no accepted installment settlement on file; start doc table "Carries no accepted installment settlement offer | Nil (0.00); no settlement may be started".
- "Accept without a lump-sum offer today": the acceptance card's table "Carries no lump-sum settlement offer dated today | Not yet worked out; nil (0.00)"; the expired 2025-11-12 offer is not dated today.
- Wrong premium base: premium schedule row 1 ("premium points of the original deficiency instead of the balance"), applied because the latest broken arrangement (a plan) is 3 whole months old; plan vs settlement both count there ("the latest broken arrangement may be a plan or a settlement").
- Wrong count source: settlement_installment_count line 1 reads only payment-plan offers ("a broken settlement is not") — here a plan, so line 1 applies.
- Factor findability: contract tier/payments "as recorded under Retail Installment Contracts"; recovery method and gross sale proceeds "on the Repossession and Collateral Recovery case"; book value "recorded on the Retail Installment Contract"; offers' hardship documents and statuses; ledger returns. Each reachable from the records' own words.
- Observation for step 2: "Order of the figures" paragraphs in installment_settlement_amount_calculation ("A schedule that replaces the installment premium is applied first; the surcharge points of the schedules that apply are then added together…"), lump_sum_amount_calculation ("The percentage points of the surcharge schedules that apply are added…; any reduction amount a schedule sets…") and settlement_installment_calculation ("A schedule that replaces the standard number of installments is applied first; the installment cuts … and the installment additions…") signal that modifiers exist; check against the source baseline in step 3b.
